clusters.headline: Sufmi Dasco Ahmad Emerges As Potential Candidate For Vice President
aiSummaryBullets: Sufmi Dasco Ahmad is increasingly cited as a primary candidate to replace Gibran Rakabuming Raka as vice president.
Support for Dasco has emerged from various political factions and labor organizations, citing his compatibility with President Prabowo.

clusters.headline: Broad Political Support Emerges For Sufmi Dasco Ahmad As Vice President
aiSummaryBullets: Multiple political parties, including PKS and NasDem, have expressed support for Sufmi Dasco Ahmad as a vice president candidate.
Labor groups like KSPSI are backing Dasco due to his perceived attentiveness to workers' rights.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Subianto Outlines ASEAN Cooperation Priorities
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto urged ASEAN member states to transform into a technology industrial hub rather than remaining only a consumer market.
The President called for enhanced regional coordination to effectively combat transnational crimes and strengthen mechanisms for crisis prevention.

clusters.headline: MPR Sets December 9 For Vice Presidential Election Selection Session
aiSummaryBullets: The MPR has officially scheduled the vice presidential selection and inauguration session for December 9, 2026.
President Prabowo is required to submit two candidates for the position no later than November 25, 2026.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Expands International And Regional Partnerships
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo proposed strategic collaborations with South Korea in the energy and semiconductor sectors.
ASEAN member states reached a consensus on utilizing space technology to support regional economic growth and disaster mitigation efforts.

clusters.headline: Police Advance Investigation Into Kupang Regent Rape Allegations
aiSummaryBullets: Police in East Nusa Tenggara have seized clothing items as evidence following an inspection of the Kupang Regent's official residence.
Regional Police Chief Irjen Pol. Reza Arief Dewanto committed to conducting a transparent investigation without external interference.

clusters.headline: Government Announces New Formula For 2027 Minimum Wage Policy
aiSummaryBullets: The 2027 provincial minimum wage is scheduled for official announcement on November 21.
The new calculation mechanism is based on the Law on Worker Protection and incorporates standard living requirements as key variables.

clusters.headline: Significant Magnitude 7.1 Earthquake Strikes The Banda Sea Region
aiSummaryBullets: A tectonic earthquake with a magnitude of 7.1 was recorded in the Banda Sea near Southeast Maluku.
Tremors were reported across multiple areas in the Maluku and Papua regions early Tuesday.

clusters.headline: Police Ethics Tribunal Evaluates Irjen Eko Hadi Over Wiretap Case
aiSummaryBullets: The Indonesian National Police initiated an ethics hearing for Irjen Eko Hadi Santoso concerning allegations of illegal wiretapping against President Prabowo Subianto.
Komjen Hendro Pandowo is presiding over the commission, supported by several high-ranking police officials serving as committee members.

clusters.headline: Proposed Relocation Of Javan Rhinos To Alas Purwo Faces Opposition
aiSummaryBullets: Government officials propose moving Javan rhinos from Ujung Kulon to Alas Purwo National Park, citing the need for a second habitat.
Indigenous Badui elders, local government representatives, and lawmakers have requested a review of the relocation strategy.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Traffic Police Confirm Driving Licenses Remain Five-Year
aiSummaryBullets: Traffic police authorities in Indonesia have formally refuted circulating claims that driving licenses could be valid for a lifetime.
Current national traffic regulations mandate that driving license holders must undergo renewal processes every five years.

clusters.headline: Jakarta Traffic Disruptions Expected During Scheduled Public Protests
aiSummaryBullets: Traffic flow in Jakarta may be hindered by planned public demonstrations.
Motorists are advised to utilize alternative routes and designated parking areas during protest activities.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Attorney General To Question Bekasi Mayor In KSO Case
aiSummaryBullets: The Attorney General's Office summoned the Mayor of Bekasi, Tri Adhianto, for questioning regarding a joint operation case.
The inquiry is part of an ongoing investigation into alleged corruption involving the management of city-owned energy enterprises.

clusters.headline: Raffi Ahmad Issues Apology Amidst Government Project Controversy
aiSummaryBullets: Raffi Ahmad apologized for his involvement in projects with two ministries and pledged to donate Rp15 billion to disaster-affected regions.
The public figure stated he consulted with the Corruption Eradication Commission (KPK) regarding his professional engagements in 2024.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Political Scrutiny Follows Vice President Resignation
aiSummaryBullets: Media coverage is currently focused on the retirement entitlements and security provisions applicable to Gibran Rakabuming Raka.
Political parties and local officials are responding to the vacancy, with some organizations reaffirming their support for the current administration.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Police Launch Nationwide Zebra Traffic Enforcement Drive
aiSummaryBullets: Regional police units across Indonesia have initiated the two-week Zebra 2026 traffic enforcement campaign.
Authorities are utilizing electronic traffic law enforcement systems alongside manual officer patrols to target specific violations.

clusters.headline: KPK Detains Former Staff Of Anwar Sadad In East Java Grant Case
aiSummaryBullets: The KPK has detained Bagus Wahyudiono, a former staff member of Anwar Sadad, regarding an ongoing corruption case involving provincial grants.
Investigators have seized two properties belonging to the suspect as part of the probe into grant misuse in East Java between 2019 and 2022.

clusters.headline: Fire Damages Twelve Homes At A Military Housing Complex In Bogor
aiSummaryBullets: A fire destroyed twelve residential properties located at a military housing complex in the Lawanggintung area of Bogor.
Emergency response teams, including firefighters and Brimob water cannon units, contained the blaze after a three-and-a-half-hour effort.

clusters.headline: Mohamad Sohibul Iman Inaugurated As New MPR RI Deputy Chairman
aiSummaryBullets: Mohamad Sohibul Iman officially replaced Hidayat Nur Wahid as Deputy Chairman of the People's Consultative Assembly (MPR) of Indonesia.
The inauguration ceremony for the interim replacement took place at the Parliament Complex in Senayan, Jakarta.

clusters.headline: Ministry Of Religious Affairs Promotes Integrated Cross-Disciplinary Research
aiSummaryBullets: The Ministry of Religious Affairs advocates for the integration of diverse research disciplines to address current global challenges.
The proposed research framework aims to bridge religious studies with humanitarian and scientific fields.
